name: Revenue by month
description: Monthly revenue, profit and orders for one year.

definition.sql:
SELECT d.month, d.month_name, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue, round(sum(f.profit), 2) AS profit,
       count(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders
FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f
JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key
WHERE d.year = :year
GROUP BY d.month, d.month_name
ORDER BY d.month

name: Top products in a category
description: Best selling products of a category by revenue, with margin.

definition.sql:
SELECT p.product_name, p.brand, sum(f.quantity) AS units, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue,
       round(100.0 * sum(f.profit) / sum(f.net_amount), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f
JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id
WHERE p.category = :category
GROUP BY p.product_name, p.brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT :top_n

name: Customer value segments
description: Customers by lifetime-value segment and customer segment, from the gold_customer_ltv table.

definition.sql:
SELECT l.ltv_segment, c.segment AS customer_segment, count(*) AS customers,
       round(avg(l.lifetime_revenue), 2) AS avg_lifetime_revenue, round(avg(l.avg_order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value, round(avg(l.recency_days), 0) AS avg_recency_days
FROM retail_lakehouse.gold_customer_ltv l
JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
GROUP BY l.ltv_segment, c.segment
ORDER BY l.ltv_segment, c.segment

name: Daily sales, last N days
description: Net revenue and orders per day for the most recent days in the data.

definition.sql:
SELECT sale_date, orders, net_revenue, profit
FROM retail_lakehouse.gold_daily_sales
WHERE sale_date > (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM retail_lakehouse.gold_daily_sales) - :days
ORDER BY sale_date

name: Web funnel by device
description: Sessions that reached each funnel step, by device, with the conversion rate.

definition.sql:
SELECT device, sessions, carts, checkouts, purchases, round(100.0 * purchases / sessions, 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM (
  SELECT device, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
         count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN session_id END) AS carts,
         count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'checkout_start' THEN session_id END) AS checkouts,
         count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN session_id END) AS purchases
  FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_web_events
  GROUP BY device)
ORDER BY sessions DESC

name: Store performance ranking
description: Revenue and margin per store, ranked; optionally limited to one region.

definition.sql:
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(f.net_amount) DESC) AS rank, s.store_name, s.region, s.format,
       round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue, round(100.0 * sum(f.profit) / sum(f.net_amount), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f
JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
WHERE s.region = coalesce(:region, s.region)
GROUP BY s.store_name, s.region, s.format
ORDER BY rank

name: Channel mix by quarter
description: Revenue per sales channel and quarter with each channel's share of the quarter.

definition.sql:
SELECT d.year, d.quarter, f.channel, round(sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS revenue,
       round(100.0 * sum(f.net_amount) / sum(sum(f.net_amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, d.quarter), 1) AS share_pct
FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales f
JOIN retail_lakehouse.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key
GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter, f.channel
ORDER BY d.year, d.quarter, f.channel

name: Discount impact on margin
description: How deeper discounts change units, revenue and margin.

definition.sql:
SELECT discount_pct, count(*) AS lines, sum(quantity) AS units, round(sum(net_amount), 2) AS revenue,
       round(100.0 * sum(profit) / sum(net_amount), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales
GROUP BY discount_pct
ORDER BY discount_pct

name: Raw files reconcile with the table
description: Compares the raw CSV export in Files/ with the fact_sales Delta table.

definition.sql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM read_csv('Files/raw/sales/*.csv')) AS csv_lines,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales) AS table_lines,
       (SELECT round(sum(net_amount), 2) FROM read_csv('Files/raw/sales/*.csv')) AS csv_revenue,
       (SELECT round(sum(net_amount), 2) FROM retail_lakehouse.fact_sales) AS table_revenue
